title: Work email
prompt: Write an email to a client telling them their website launch will slip two weeks, from March 3 to March 17, because the payment provider's API review is taking longer than planned. Offer a call this week.

title: Cover letter
prompt: Write a short cover letter for a backend engineer with 6 years of Go and Postgres experience applying to a mid-size logistics company. They led a migration that cut p99 latency from 900 ms to 180 ms.

title: Product announcement
prompt: Write a short blog post announcing that our note-taking app now syncs offline edits and resolves conflicts automatically. It ships today on iOS and Android; desktop follows next month.

title: README intro
prompt: Write the opening section of a README for 'tidepool', a command-line tool that downloads NOAA tide predictions for a station ID and prints the next high and low tides. Include install and a usage example.

title: PR description
prompt: Write a pull request description for a change that replaces our hand-rolled retry loop in the billing worker with exponential backoff and jitter, adds a max of 5 attempts, and adds tests. It fixes a bug where failed charges retried every second forever.

title: Op-ed
prompt: Write three paragraphs of an op-ed arguing that cities should remove parking minimums for new apartment buildings.

title: Story opening
prompt: Write the opening 200 words of a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a stranger's boot on the rocks after a storm.

title: Status update
prompt: Write a weekly status update to my team: the data pipeline migration is 70% done, two tables are blocked on a schema decision from the analytics team, and we found that the nightly job was silently skipping rows with null timestamps; that's now fixed.
